item_name: Rothco 2A "Shall Not Be Infringed" Low Profile Cap - Black
item_short_desc: Showcase your support for the Second Amendment with Rothco’s 2A "Shall Not Be Infringed" Low Profile Cap. The front panel proudly displays embroidered “2A” and “Shall Not Be Infringed” lettering, making a bold statement. Made from durable and lightweight brushed cotton twill, this cap offers long-lasting comfort. The structured buckram front panel ensures the cap retains its shape, while the internal sweatband keeps sweat out of your eyes. Top ventilation holes enhance airflow to keep your head cool in warm weather.
